The '''Qulun camp''' was a camp used by the [[Qulun]], a non-traditional trading clan of the [[Alwari]] tribes native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. The Qulun constantly moved around Ansion, setting up camp when they traded.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], four [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]—[[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]—along with [[Kyakhta]], [[Bulgan]], and [[Tooqui]], while believing themselves to be guests of trader-chief [[Baiuntu]], were in fact his captives and, upon being freed by Tooqui, fought the Qulun in a [[Skirmish in the Qulun camp|skirmish in their camp]].<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />
